wish: someone should make a player that skips silent parts of audio and video
spec:
Plays an audio or video file from your device and jumps over every stretch quieter than your threshold.
Open a file, set the quiet level and the shortest gap worth skipping, press play; the timeline shades what will be skipped.
Does not edit or export the file and never uploads it; very large files fast-forward through quiet parts live instead of jumping.
notes: Offline: the file is read locally as a data URL (the CSP allows media-src data: only). Silence is found ahead of time by decoding the audio track; if the browser cannot decode it, or the file is over 400 MB, it switches to live detection and plays quiet parts at 8x.
